title: Discover-consistent Network toolbar with complete filtered browsing
summary: Align Network spacing, tab baseline and compact search/Filters controls with Discover, reuse one responsive filter-panel shell across both pages, keep invitation/connection sorting inside Network Filters, and preserve per-section URL state with complete server-side filtered browsing.
dataSourcesChanged: Extend the existing connection-feed reader with public skills, literal location, saved collaboration and live shared-connection predicates before LIMIT.
Read pending connection requests, project invitations and incoming applications through one scoped, keyset-paginated Network reader with complete-result search and direction/type filtering.
Reuse canonical skill visibility and mutual-count projections for filtering and person-card detail. No schema change, persisted data rewrite, additional polling or mutation-service change.
concurrencyRisk: Each tab has a separate URL state and query key. Invitation reads use the existing pending invalidation prefix without entering the pending-request optimistic cache shape. Existing handlers retain decisions and error feedback; filtered views hide global Cancel all. Cursor tuples include source and id and preserve database microseconds. Privacy is checked before filters and metadata projection; blocked, deleted, expired and unauthorized items are excluded. Failed next-page reads retain existing cards and require explicit retry.

rollback.strategy: Revert only this toolbar/browse change set, preserving pre-existing person-card, rail, settings and Messages work. No database rollback is needed.
validation: Existing relationship and project review actions still work
Canonical private skills cannot match public filters
Unfiltered Network lists still paginate and all tabs retain their existing access rules
